summary: 5 errors, 22 minor across 14 of 40 units. All 16 text_flags checked and upheld: each rests on grammar or on evidence inside the chunk (sattvasaṃjñakaḥ, bavanti, manortho, sātmaya, upadekṣayāmo, upasprśet, dargeṣu, mahotsāḥ, kulacchāyām, nocchair, mṛdgīyāt, catyuṣpatha, sarpibhyaḥ, udakāntaritāt, maṅgalākriyāsu, nātyuccari); none relies on another edition or memory. Errors: malāyana not rendered per glossary (18, english+gloss); wrong etymology sava for savya (19 notes); two notes resting on outside knowledge to remove (24 'usually taken as an eclipse', 28 'opening words of a mantra'). No regrouping suggested. Glossary additions proposed: upekṣā among virtues = equanimity (upekṣā); smṛti in sadvṛtta = mindfulness (smṛti); vikāra of the elements = modification; kriyā (activity of a substance) = activity (kriyā); śleṣman as bodily discharge = phlegm (श्लेष्मा); upacāra of persons = behaviour/manners; vāyu/agni/soma/arka as objects one faces = wind/fire/moon/sun; Agni, Vāyu, Viṣṇu, Indra named as deities in mantras = names; malāyana = channels of waste (already, apply); pañcapañcaka = the five pentads; sadvṛtta lists: hetau īrṣyuḥ = emulous in the means.
